physicalNotes: Radius 0.715 +/- 0.005 solar radii from Zingales et al. 2025, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-1803 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...695A.273Z/abstract): 497,426 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.756 +/- 0.05 solar masses from Zingales et al. 2025, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-1803 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...695A.273Z/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 4687 +/- 65 K from Zingales et al. 2025, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-1803 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...695A.273Z/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
